create_tensor_proto_external_data: create a TensorProto with external data from a PyTorch tensor saved to a separate file
save_model_external_data: save an ONNX model with external data initializers loaded from PyTorch serialized tensor files
match_tensor_names_onnx: match PyTorch tensor names to ONNX input names with suffix-based resolution
rename_initializer_names: rename ONNX initializer names by replacing dots with underscores for FXSymbolicTracer compatibility
load_tensors_attach_initializers: load serialized PyTorch tensors and attach them as external initializers to an ONNX model
